exposure: Non-recurrent indications for previous caesarean section
outcome: Successful vaginal birth after caesarean section (VBAC)
cohort: 186 women with one previous caesarean section
finding: History of previous vaginal delivery and non-recurrent indications for previous caesarean section were significant predictors of successful VBAC.
birth_weight: Birthweight less than 4kg was a predictor of successful VBAC
